tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations are monotone and concave in u_now but cover only a narrow gradient range. A discriminating probe is needed before selecting a model for confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the Haldane, Cobb-Douglas, or siphon law directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies u_now but holds s_grad near 1, so it cannot reliably distinguish the gradient dependence or an unobserved high-gradient branch.
The cheaper open-branch probe more directly addresses the present identifiability ambiguity.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
